collection.title: Mazda MX-5 2005 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mazda MX-5 2005 to 2014 model requires a 18" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
